backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining inventory, sales, exchange rates, customers, and user profile management with access control and storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature report mapping features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files for reference or documentation.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme setup defining light and dark OKLCH color variables and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines TanStack Router routes and wraps all pages in the AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/customers/Overdu: Component showing overdue credit alerts with text variants and localization.
frontend/src/components/inventory/Invent: Create/edit inventory item dialog with image upload, auto‑pricing, and form state management.
frontend/src/components/LargeButton.tsx: Large styled wrapper around the shadcn Button component.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with navigation, global search, and CSV export logic, fetching data via hooks and triggering downloads.
frontend/src/components/search/GlobalSea: Implements a searchable dialog for inventory items with debounced queries and keyboard shortcut activation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidates dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Provides a hook that delays updating a value until after a specified timeout.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, exposing login, logout, and identity context through a provider and hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for inventory, customers, exchange rates, and mutations using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes, applying global color and layout tokens.
frontend/src/lib/csvExport.ts: Utility functions to escape values, convert arrays to CSV strings, and trigger CSV file downloads.
frontend/src/lib/currency.ts: Currency formatting and conversion helpers for USD, VES, and COP, including multi-currency display.
frontend/src/lib/datasetSerializers.ts: Serializes inventory, customer, cashbox, and exchange rate objects into CSV-friendly arrays and defines corresponding header labels.
frontend/src/lib/fileToBytes.ts: Converts a File to a byte array and creates an image URL from raw bytes.
frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts: Contains centralized Spanish translation keys and values used throughout the UI.
frontend/src/lib/inventoryPricing.ts: Provides functions to calculate selling prices from margins and derive margins from prices.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Offers a class name merger helper and a simple unique ID generator.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers and renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/CashboxPage.tsx: Displays cashbox balances and entries, supports filtering, and includes a form to add new cashbox movements.
frontend/src/pages/ClosuresPage.tsx: Static page describing closure-related features and indicating backend support is required.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerDetailPage.ts: Shows detailed customer info including debt and overdue sales, with navigation and backend-required notice.
frontend/src/pages/CustomersPage.tsx: Lists customers, highlights overdue ones, and provides a dialog to add new customers.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard aggregating inventory, customer debt, overdue sales, and analytics with KPI cards and alerts.
frontend/src/pages/InventoryPage.tsx: Inventory management page with category filtering, low‑stock alerts, and add/edit item form handling.
frontend/src/pages/RatesPage.tsx: Exchange rate viewer and form for adding new USD→VES/COP rate entries.
frontend/src/pages/SalesPage.tsx: Sales workflow with product search, cart management, price types, and sale submission with payment options.
frontend/src/pages/SupplierDetailPage.ts: Placeholder supplier detail view showing supplier ID and backend‑required notice.
frontend/src/pages/SuppliersPage.tsx: Static suppliers module overview displaying a backend‑required alert and planned features.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, and plugins including container queries and animate.
project_state.json: Defines project state, listing issues, existing features, and pending backend analytics feature requests.
